chunks: And Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding one who entered ihram in Masjid al-Shajarah, then had intercourse with his spouse before reciting the talbiyah, he said: “There is nothing upon him.”

key_terms.الْإِحْرَامَ: the state of consecration for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ الشَّجَرَةِ: Masjid al-Shajarah, a miqat for entering ihram
key_terms.يُلَبِّيَ: to recite the talbiyah of ihram

ai.seo_question: Is there any penalty for having intercourse after entering ihram but before reciting the talbiyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person who entered ihram at Masjid al-Shajarah and then had intercourse with his spouse before reciting the talbiyah. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that no liability or penalty is upon him in that case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2565 - Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding someone who entered Ihram at Masjid al-Shajarah and then had intercourse with his spouse before reciting the Talbiyah.
Imam (as) said: "There is nothing upon him [no penalty]."
